column1: # One code may have many rows — one per variant you stock. Some codes cover
# several sizes (Infinix X6725 is 64 or 128 GB); Samsung-style codes usually
# don't. The app shows the rows as buttons; it never fills a field on its own.
#   code      letters and digits only, uppercase. SM-S928B and "sm s928b" and
#             MT9Q2TH/A all normalise the same way as the lookup does.
#   region    free text, blank if it doesn't matter. iPhone part-number suffix
#             (LL, ZP, TH, CH, JP) or Android Global / China / India.
#   numbers   whole numbers, no units. Blank = leave that field alone.
#   cpu/gpu   shown on screen only, never printed on the tag.
# Blank fields still need their tabs:  X6725<TAB><TAB>128<TAB>8<TAB><TAB><TAB>
# Ships empty on purpose — fill it from the boxes you actually sell.
